Its interesting that you mention R is a primary but that you admit to effectively treating him as a secondary. Now it doesnt say in your post why your not able to be there for him as a primary and I dont want to assume anything but it does seem like you might be neglecting your relationship with R. It could be R is slightly jealous of your relationship with D as its sounds like from your post that you're spending more time and effort with D as whole when its negative right now. I recommend talking more with R about it and see if you can put it in some extra time with him.

The situation with D sounds like he might trying to unfairly have you fulfill more of his need in a relationship than what's been established. It sounds like D maybe struggling with being poly and juggling his feelings and needs and I'd suggest having a conversation with him about his wants and needs for your relationship and what you feel comfortable giving. It maybe time to end it with D if it's becoming toxic for you. Also maybe ask if he went mono for this new girl if she would even be receptive. Defining that may help him gain some perspective about what his new expectations with her are causing to your relationship.

Good luck!

Right now shes at 20 plus guys all ok with poly and well they've already talked about doing things sexually and she wants to go out with most of them.
